finding: Using raw language only as an auxiliary variable that indexes latent distribution changes is covered by auxiliary-variable nonlinear ICA; temporal history and multimodal shared-latent identifiability further narrow the claim.
surviving_claim: Compositional relations among raw utterances must remove a causal-model equivalence that remains after conditioning on complete trajectories and after quotienting out every use of language as a mere auxiliary/environment index.
adoption_blockers: no proof beyond auxiliary-variable nonlinear ICA and multimodal CRL
R0.1 public capability baseline not reproduced
